title: Implement Pyodide Python Code Block Rendering in Existing Markdown Pipeline
description: Add Python executable fenced-block support to the current Markdig path in MemorySmith.App by extending ChatMarkdownRenderer, MermaidExtension, and code block renderers so python fences emit py-cell placeholders without regressing Mermaid or Prism behavior.

comments.author: Agent Smith
comments.message: Vetting note: repository does not contain MemorySmith.Markdown or MemorySmith.Web projects. Real integration points are MemorySmith.App/Services/ChatMarkdownRenderer.cs, MermaidExtension.cs, PrismCodeBlockRenderer.cs, and MermaidBlockRenderer.cs.
